evidence: 442 full notice histories; 1511 revisions; publicationDate and version retained, cancellations applied as-of. Generation and consumption units plus FI-EE/FI-SE1/FI-SE3 directional corridor notices.
availability: ceil_hour(publicationDate + 5 minutes). Never use current isOutdated flags to rewrite earlier views.
limitation: Public archive completeness is checked against listing totals, not independently certified; corridor reductions are not exact per-cable physical outage MW.

evidence: Public catalogue inspection identified 245 (updates every 15 minutes) and 246 (once daily). Local 245 archive has datasetId/startTime/endTime/value only, 15456 rows, no duplicated delivery timestamps and no issue/version timestamps. No alternative versioned intraday wind archive was established.
availability: Cannot infer historical availability of overwritten values from delivery timestamps.
limitation: This is a finding about inspected sources, not proof that no other archive exists.

evidence: Individual DMI HARMONIE AROME Europe runs sampled every 3 hours and ICON-EU every 6 hours; 100m wind speed and direction at Raahe, Oulu and Vaasa. Same locations and relative weights drawn from existing ECMWF proxy; predeclared three-location subset limits download volume.
availability: Model initialisation + 6 hours, an assumed conservative operational delay. Only complete archived runs, no seamless analysis substitution.
limitation: Historical actual API ingestion times are not supplied. Results are conditional on the stated delay. Forecasts are regional proxies, not official revised Fingrid wind-production forecasts.

evidence: Nord Pool historical intraday trades require an appropriate subscription. No such credentials are configured. No equivalent public ENTSO-E historical trade feed with trade/publication timestamps was established.
availability: Would require trades published before each origin; final delivery-period averages cannot replace an as-of traded price.
limitation: No purchase, account creation or external messages were made.

evidence: Elering public system and balance schemas and one-day samples inspected. Measurement timestamps are present; publication/version timestamps are absent. Sample balance values were null. No verified historical publication archive was established for additional Swedish/Norwegian measurements. Swedish Mimer production statistics are settlement data, with newer records redirected to eSett; the new SDS portal launched June 2026. Statnett documents measurement aggregation and delayed corrections, without an archived as-of publication history established here.
availability: A historical measurement timestamp is not proof of the value available at a forecast origin.
limitation: Existing package neighbour prices and flows remain in the baseline. This experiment does not test all possible neighbour feeds.

evidence: Active quarterly mFRR up/down bid-volume datasets 373/374 identified. No FINGRID_API_KEY configured; no local archive for these IDs. Public descriptions reference final available bid statuses but do not establish historical early publication versions.
availability: Must establish publication timing before using as forward reserve-tightness features.
limitation: Existing activated reserves, calculated imbalance and scheduled-activation prices remain in the baseline; new bid/capacity series were not benchmarked.
